steps.text:
I recorded both probes as `Answered · fail · 2026-10-18` and committed `docs/probes.md` (commit `cff6bae`). Lint reports 0 errors.

- **PB-01 (Sharadar):** fail. The S&P 500 file your plan returns starts in 2007 and covers about 40 stocks, so it can't give membership back to 2000. The full price download also came back empty, so prices weren't checked.
- **PB-02 (Yahoo):** fail. Yahoo refused 94% of the requests for current members (HTTP 429, too many requests), and yahooquery dropped those stocks without any error. Closes were never compared with Sharadar, because PB-01 had no prices to compare.

Since you can't ask Sharadar or check your plan page, the measured results are what the redesign has to work from: about 40 stocks of S&P 500 history from 2007.

Next is `/dev-team:architecture-design`, which revises AD-03 (Sharadar as the main source) and AD-04 (Yahoo as the cross-check) based on these results. It should also fix AD-03's route to `api.sharadar.com`. It will raise LOAD-06's delisting-date question for spec-writing; the spec changes only if you agree.
